_about: What is still on the page after round 1b, each with its pattern (patterns.json) and its kind — surface: it came back on a surface built this round, by agents who had been told the rules · feed: a limit of the feed or of the generator · yours: left for his call on purpose · process: a slip in how the work was done, not on the page. Sources: the fix lanes' reports (F1a 89d99e0, F1b 699f0c2, F2 978ed30), the round-1b measure (measures.r1b.json) and the merge (6d5e9c5). 'status' is open until a pass fixes it; a fixing pass sets it to 'fixed <sha>'. Kept as evidence: the patterns came back on surfaces built by agents who had been told the rules.
